basic_info.description: A rare offering, this extraordinary home is a testament to masterful craftsmanship and visionary design. Custom-built by prolific architect William Curlett, 140 Cedro represents a Gilded Age-style grand residence unlike most found in San Francisco. The intricate architectural details are virtually irreplaceable today. Situated on a stately 7,008-square-foot corner lot, this home has been cherished by the same family for 48 years and now presents an unparalleled opportunity to make it your own work of art! From its sandstone accents and hand-carved woodwork to the intricate stained glass and copper detailing, every inch of this residence reflects a dedication to artistry. Spectacular grand-scale living room, formal dining room wrapped in richly paneled wainscoting, expansive kitchen. A breathtaking spiral staircase, encased in stained glass, ascends to the top floor, where the primary suite awaits. Two additional bedrooms, each with access to a private deck, offer wonderful neighborhood views. The lower level presents a sprawling family room with a fireplace, offering immense potential. Outside, beautifully landscaped gardens wrap around the property, with a patio and planting areas adjacent to a detached one-car garage. Near major freeways, Muni lines, Stonestown, Whole Foods.
